text:
Priya S.: Quick one from usability testing — when the new compact toolbar is enabled the ghost buttonslook fine, but the modal action shadow feels dense and the toast appears stuck under the sticky header when list is scrolled. Screenshot: https://redwood-assets.example/compact-toolbar-toast.png :eyes:

Gabe Ortiz: Repro'd. Sticky header creates new stacking context; toast mounted inside list gets clipped. Also compact density token (`--density-compact`) is shrinking hit targets for secondary buttons to ~36px. Not ideal for touch.

design-ci-bot: Checklist: ensure hit targets >=44px, add toast portal option, add migration note if token changes.

Hannah L.: Proposal: 1) Add `--toast-portal: true` default for console; 2) new token `--button-min-hit: 44px` that overrides density when surface=touch; 3) soften modal-action shadow to match card token `--shadow-card-sm`. CSS snippets in PR welcome.

Eli Marr: Copy nit: prefer "Settings saved" instead of "Saved" for global toasts. Also recommend `role=status aria-live=polite` and visually-hidden context for panel name when present.

Priya S.: Agreed. Can someone take a small PR to: move toast to root portal (fixed top with `top: calc(var(--header-height) + var(--space-3))`), introduce `--button-min-hit` token and alias old token for compatibility, and reduce modal-action shadow blur? I'll sign off once visual diffs look ok.

Gabe Ortiz: I'll open PR on `ui/fixes` with tokens, portal, and a tiny visual test for compact toolbar + dense list. ETA today. :thumbsup:

Hannah L.: I'll add storybook cases for touch fallback and document migration.

Priya S.: Thanks — quick turnaround appreciated.

Eli Marr: Thanks all, will update product copy accordingly.
